requirements.title: Notification Preference Configuration
requirements.requirement: Customers must be able to configure notification preferences via the UI, including frequency, channels, and transaction types.
requirements.reasoning: Security compliance requires authorization for operations (security_compliance_reqs.md | Enforce authorization server-side), and UI access to preferences is necessary for customer control. [Assumption] Notification preferences are considered customer data requiring secure configuration.

requirements.title: Immutable Audit Logs for Preferences
requirements.requirement: All changes to notification preferences must be logged with timestamps, actor IDs, and outcome codes in immutable audit records.
requirements.reasoning: Immutable audit records are required for authentication and authorization failures (security_compliance_reqs.md | Write immutable audit records), which applies to preference changes. [Assumption] Preference modifications are treated as operational events requiring audit tracking.

requirements.title: Data Encryption for Preferences
requirements.requirement: Notification preference data must be encrypted at rest using approved encryption standards.
requirements.reasoning: Security compliance mandates encryption for sensitive data (security_compliance_reqs.md | Encrypt sensitive data with TLS 1.2 or newer in transit and approved encryption at rest). [Assumption] Notification preferences are considered sensitive customer data.
source_references: security_compliance_reqs.md | Encrypt sensitive data with TLS 1.2 or newer in transit and approved encryption at rest

requirements.title: HTTPS for Preference UI
requirements.requirement: All UI interactions for configuring notification preferences must use HTTPS.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations require HTTPS for secure communication (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Use HTTPS). [Assumption] Preference configuration is a customer-facing operation requiring secure transport.

requirements.title: Error Handling for Preference Changes
requirements.requirement: Failed preference changes must return stable machine-readable error codes and correlation IDs.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations mandate error code standards for failed requests (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Return stable machine-readable error codes). [Assumption] Preference changes are treated as operational requests requiring error reporting.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Return stable machine-readable error codes

requirements.title: Preference Retention Period
requirements.requirement: Notification preference records must be retained for at least 7 years or the applicable regulatory period.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations require immutable transaction records and audit logs for 7 years (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Retain immutable transaction records and audit logs for at least 7 years). [Assumption] Preference data is treated as operational records requiring retention.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Retain immutable transaction records and audit logs for at least 7 years

requirements.title: Preference UI Availability
requirements.requirement: Notification preference configuration must maintain 99.95% monthly availability for core account APIs.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations mandate 99.95% availability for core APIs (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Maintain at least 99.95% monthly availability for core account and transaction APIs). [Assumption] Preference configuration is part of core account functionality.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Maintain at least 99.95% monthly availability for core account and transaction APIs

requirements.title: Preference Redaction
requirements.requirement: Personally identifiable data in preference logs must be redacted according to documented retention schedules.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations require redaction of PII from logs (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Redact personally identifiable data from logs). [Assumption] Preference data may contain PII requiring redaction.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Redact personally identifiable data from logs

requirements.title: Response Time for Preference Changes
requirements.requirement: Preference change requests must complete in under 500 ms for 95% of interactions.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations specify 500 ms for balance inquiries (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Complete 95% of balance inquiries in under 500 ms). [Assumption] Preference changes are treated similarly to balance inquiries for latency requirements.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Complete 95% of balance inquiries in under 500 ms

requirements.title: Correlation ID for Preference Requests
requirements.requirement: All preference-related requests must include and propagate correlation IDs for traceability.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations require correlation IDs for failed requests (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Return stable machine-readable error codes, sanitized customer messages, and correlation IDs for every failed request). [Assumption] Preference operations are treated as transactional requests requiring traceability.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Return stable machine-readable error codes, sanitized customer messages, and correlation IDs for every failed request

requirements.title: Structured Logging for Preferences
requirements.requirement: Preference-related logs must include timestamps, actor IDs, and outcome codes in structured format.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations mandate structured logging for traceability (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Use HTTPS). [Assumption] Preference operations require structured logging for audit and debugging.

requirements.title: Preference UI Scalability
requirements.requirement: The preference configuration UI must support concurrent user sessions without degradation.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations imply scalability for core account APIs (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Maintain at least 99.95% monthly availability for core account and transaction APIs). [Assumption] Preference configuration is part of core account functionality requiring scalability.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Maintain at least 99.95% monthly availability for core account and transaction APIs

requirements.title: Preference Data Integrity
requirements.requirement: Preference data must remain consistent across all system components during configuration.
requirements.reasoning: Account transaction rules require consistency for debits (account_transactions_reqs.md | Check available balance before debit). [Assumption] Preference data integrity is analogous to transactional consistency requirements.
source_references: account_transactions_reqs.md | Check available balance before debit

requirements.title: Preference UI Accessibility
requirements.requirement: Notification preference configuration must be accessible to users with disabilities via compliant UI standards.
requirements.reasoning: Non-functional operations imply accessibility for core account APIs (non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Maintain at least 99.95% monthly availability for core account and transaction APIs). [Assumption] Preference configuration is part of core account functionality requiring accessibility compliance.
source_references: non_functional_operations_reqs.md | Maintain at least 99.95% monthly availability for core account and transaction APIs
